<function name="GetMother" parent="DListBoxItem" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns the parent "mother" of this **DListBoxItem** set by <page>DListBoxItem:SetMother</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret type="DListBox">The "mother" <page>DListBox</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
